reviews.name: Liss
reviews.body: These pads have 100% changed my skin for the better. My skin has never had such a sheen hours after using them. I use them at night and wake up the next day with the best skin i've ever had. Had no redness, no breakouts. You get a really good amount of pads per pot and i only use one at a time. The pores around my nose have never been so clear, they are smooth and overall my skin is less bumpy. I have sensitive skin and the mild ones are perfect!

reviews.name: KK98
reviews.body: I love these pads! Even though my pores were minimal, these have really made a difference. I went for the sensitive ones as my skin is prone to perioral dermatitis - I use these every night and have not had a flare up at all.

reviews.name: 2003s
reviews.body: Amazing I have used the normal blues ones but love these so much better for my skin my skin looks like glass

reviews.name: Sharon
reviews.body: I can’t be without this product! My skin loves how gentle and calming the pads are and I love how easily they remove makeup residue and give an instant refresh to my face.

reviews.name: Noonoo
reviews.body: I purchased this for my teen daughter, her skin is in nice condition, but can have flare-ups with oily skin and spots during her monthly cycle. She uses these in an evening, popping them where needed for an hour or two and by the morning her skin is much clearer. She sometimes cuts them in half to be able to apply to certain areas, we are very happy with the results, a thumbs up.

reviews.name: AW91
reviews.body: Love, would recommend as someone with sensitive skin

reviews.name: Caroline
reviews.body: It just makes your skin feel so smooth and cleaning for that extra clean feeling after removing make up and cleansing

reviews.name: Pat
reviews.body: I was so surprised how brilliant the pads are, my skin is Amazing!  So happy with the results.

reviews.name: Linda B
reviews.body: Second purchase, give a really good glow to the skin and keep it clear. Wouldn't be without it now.

reviews.name: Siane23
reviews.body: I bought these for my teen daughter who has just started using them so can’t really comment on long term use but so far so good, no irritation and does the job
